segments.title: Hype Train Derails Into Cigarette Rat Lore
segments.notes: Hype Train opens the broadcast with a mournful trap beat, freestyle-rhyming about the passage of time, cigarettes, and the invented history of 'crats' (cigarette rats) while acknowledging subscribers.

segments.title: Pentagon Press Corps Walkout and Venezuela Escalation
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Jeff Ripple cover the Pentagon press corps' mass exit over new Hegseth-imposed reporting restrictions, then analyze Trump's claims about Venezuelan 'fast boats' and potential land invasion.

segments.title: Bush Opinions: Beyblade, Neck Pussies, and Mickey Rourke
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein fields street opinions including a Beyblade tournament update, a man with a surgically installed neck vagina, and Mickey Mouse's nephew Mickey Rourke who poisoned his uncle with mouse pellets.

segments.title: Does Crumb's Wife Still Love Him?
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate the state of Crum's marriage; Crum reveals he's been sleeping on the couch, describes a 'comfortable valley,' and graphically details face-sitting habits to prove the magic remains.

segments.title: Jellyfish Confronts Case Over Fish Tie
segments.notes: A jellyfish (Papito-sourced) interrogates Case about wearing a cardboard fish tie, debating taxonomy and representation before expressing disappointment in Case's rudeness.

segments.title: Town Hall with John Cena and Jake
segments.notes: Town hall features a John Cena impressionist admitting to past mob crimes and threatening Jake, plus a silent suited woman and Jake's brief firing panic.

segments.title: Slop Block: Kevin Vaping, Old Men, and Beefcake Cooking
segments.notes: Rapid-fire viewing of AI-generated slop videos (Kevin vaping, brother's old-man content) and a cooking clip of a woman surrounded by beefcake husbands, rated a clean four by chat.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Friday Preview
segments.notes: Case wraps the abbreviated Wednesday stream, promises Friday return with a song, and raids out to help Kendall with cat nail clipping.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the broadcast, managed technical difficulties, moderated Munch & Crum debate, interviewed jellyfish, and hosted town hall and slop segments.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open sign-on, managed Hype Train summoning, and sourced the jellyfish guest.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Opened with freestyle rap about cigarettes, 'crats,' and subs before derailing into surreal etymology.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosted News segment on Pentagon press walkout and Trump's Venezuela rhetoric, providing legal context on classified reporting.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted bush interviews covering Beyblade tournament status, a neck-vagina enthusiast, Mickey Rourke, and a spoon of Halloween.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defended his marriage against Munch's scrutiny, revealing couch-sleeping arrangement and graphic face-sitting details.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Prosecuted the case that Crum's wife has moved on, citing the couch arrangement and roommate dynamic.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly appeared to assist with cat nail clipping and received Disney contact requests from Trip.

characters.name: Jake
characters.notes: studio staff. Appeared as town hall participant, briefly believed he was fired, then engaged in promo battle with John Cena impressionist.

storylines.beat: Trip Bradstein confirms Beyblade Four-way betathon triggers at 10 more subs; street interviewee asks who to talk to at BIN for the match. [52:32, 53:27]

lore_notes.fact: Claims 35-45 years of marriage; currently sleeping on couch in a 'comfortable valley' with scheduled morning/bedtime contact. [1:17:39, 1:19:37]
Admits he and wife practice face sitting; last occurred 'a couple months ago' before memory lapse. [1:19:16]
Bush background has apparently never been updated despite long absences. [1:14:02]
Actively clipping cat nails (Miss Zorro) with Case's assistance; seeking Disney social media contacts. [1:50:34, 1:50:56]

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the Pentagon press corps' mass resignation over Hegseth's new reporting rules and Trump's escalating Venezuela rhetoric, then pivoted to a chaotic Trip on the Street featuring a neck-vagina enthusiast and Mickey Rourke. The Munch & Crum debate descended into graphic marital revelations, a jellyfish confronted Case over his fish tie, and a John Cena impressionist threatened Jake in town hall before the broadcast closed with a slop block rated a clean four by chat.
